corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward kills artillery during eastern patrol contact; Ansel sustains him. Born projectiles remain dangerous after source death.
Midnight damages the eastern upper restraint while intercepting upper officers. Steward later destroys the western upper restraint. Ordinary operators neither block nor attack the civilian.
Melantha damages the eastern lower restraint while intercepting officers, then rotates to the western lower restraint after combat.
Fang blocks, Ansel heals, Steward damages eastern approaches and Midnight assists within actual range. Fang must not retain more enemies than his two-block capacity.
Friston blocks, Spot supplies periodic healing, Steward damages approaches and Midnight assists at [4,5]. Three-block capacity requires timely clearance, especially final armor #34.
Midnight intercepts upper outer enemies with Ansel support; eastern restraint clearance must not expose a civilian to a surviving officer.
Melantha intercepts lower outer enemies with Spot burst support. Kill each officer before the next creates a one-block overflow.

artillery_budget.central_tradeoff: Steward cannot attack enemies already held at [3,5] or [4,5]. He attacks their eastern approaches; Midnight supplies central contact through his forward column.
artillery_budget.coverage: Steward [2,7] UP contains the eastern vertical patrol from [2,7] through [5,7], including both endpoint waits.
artillery_budget.qualification: The hit mix is a sufficient budget, not an asserted attack sequence. Count actual artillery hits; device attacks, target competition and interruptions do not count.
artillery_budget.reference_sufficient_hit_mix: 36 ordinary hits at 249.10 plus 9 enhanced hits at 473.29 exceed 13000.

economy.qualification: Redeployment amounts use the supplied current-model basis. Withdrawal requires a living deployed unit; death produces no refund. No opening deployment depends on a retreat.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: Timeline actions are fixed. Conditions below are validity assertions, not new executable action types or automatic rescheduling.

lower_survival_budget.limitation: This is a per-hit budget, not a prediction of selection, splash frequency or healing allocation. Spot has no assumed dodge and does not heal before activation.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Spot [5,4] has a skill-only nine-cell range containing [4,5] and [6,5]. Ansel [2,5] RIGHT ordinarily contains [1,5], [3,5] and [2,7]. Neither coverage claim grants splash immunity.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly these seven distinct IDs; each is in normal_low_star_catalog with rarity 1–3 and normal_mode true.
All deployment coordinates are integer [row,col] on matching terrain. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Skills and retreats require the named operator to be alive and deployed. Failed survival invalidates dependent income, healing and withdrawal actions.
Spot, Friston and Melantha must survive through frame 1772; Spot must deliver actual healing before either blocker dies. Fang must survive every relied-upon grant.
Friston remains alive with free block capacity through officer #11 interception. A BLOCK followed by death is not a successful closure.
No protected-target deaths, no ordinary civilian attacks or blocks, and no assumption that an officer ignores a civilian within its 1.2 attack radius.
Actual cumulative damage must kill artillery before its return exposes protected targets or allows its leak; source death does not erase born projectiles.
Late redeployments require real cooldown and cost. No planned sacrifice, death refund or instant replacement.
Before frame 9000, verify exhausted hostile spawns, zero active hostiles, zero leaks and no unresolved dangerous projectile. If absent, this fixed rotation is invalid.
remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish all four interceptions and Spot. Preserve Fang's conditional grants. Spot must survive without healing until first activation; both lower blockers must survive the delayed medical handoff.

Use the first Spot burst to repair the lower pair, establish eastern caster contact, and retain lower interception through officer #11's former leak window. The 84–124 second Spot downtime is a decisive risk.
Preserve both central queues, kill artillery before western return and prevent officer access to either civilian. Ansel's survival is required for caster continuity.
Midnight's arts interval and Spot's third burst cover late armor and runner pressure. Clear early armor before final runners consume block capacity; explicitly account for #34.
Clear all remaining hostiles and residual projectiles before withdrawing combat operators.
Complete legal cooldowns, destroy western restraints and observe both safe arrivals. The horizon alone never establishes acceptance.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income only while alive and deployed; first grants fund the opening.
Basic attacks and blocking only; no unsupported robot talent.
Arts conversion and attack increase for restraint, outer and central damage. Repeats allow 40 active plus 70 inactive seconds.
Shorten lower-outer occupancy and support restraint clearance; repeats allow 20 active plus 40 inactive seconds.
Heal lower blockers and self; attacks stop during healing. Repeats allow 25 active plus 40 inactive seconds. Healing allocation is not guaranteed.
Upper and caster sustain; first activation follows 25 inactive seconds, repeats follow 25 active plus 35 inactive seconds. No probabilistic extra heal assumed.
Automatic enhanced attacks and supported high-defense priority; record artillery damage separately from ground-enemy and device damage.

tactical_thesis: Replace the exposed lower physician with Spot at [5,4], whose supported healing range covers both lower interceptors and whose defense provides a larger pre-skill artillery survival budget. Move Ansel to [2,5] RIGHT and Steward to [2,7] UP for ordinary medical coverage and sustained contact with the eastern artillery patrol. Midnight retains upper interception and contributes central damage. This is a complete unsimulated candidate; survival during Spot's inactive intervals, target allocation and artillery clearance remain checkable hypotheses, not a claimed WIN.
